# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This project uses CLAUDE.md as the primary configuration file.
Please read CLAUDE.md at the project root for:

- Project overview and architecture
- Build and test commands
- Coding standards and conventions
- Skill routing and context references

Key points:
- TypeScript strict mode, no `any`
- Named exports only (no `export default`)
- WCAG AA accessibility on every component
- Conventional Commits for git
- Always run typecheck + lint + test before completing tasks
- Always update .agent/context/task.md after completing a task
- Do not modify dependencies without explicit approval
